list.name: Hothead
list.text: Brilliant, but sparks fly on set.

list.title: Creative differences
list.text: {a} and {b} had creative differences on set and stopped speaking. The mood shows on screen.

list.title: Walked off set
list.text: {a} walked off set for a week after a heated argument. Reshoots cost {cost}.

list.title: Director's-cut standoff
list.text: {d} fought the studio over the final cut. The critics side with {d}.

list.title: It went viral
list.text: A behind-the-scenes clip of {a} went viral weeks before release.

list.title: Rave test screening
list.text: Test audiences cheered at the end. Word of mouth is already spreading.

list.title: Weather delays
list.text: Storms shut the shoot down for ten days. The delay cost {cost}.

list.title: Over budget
list.text: {d} kept shooting until it was perfect. The film ran {cost} over budget.

list.title: Footage leaked
list.text: Unfinished footage leaked online and the reviews of it were brutal.

list.title: Surprise cameo
list.text: A surprise cameo got audiences talking.

list.title: Chemistry off the charts
list.text: {a} and {b} became fast friends, and it shows in every scene.

list.title: Awards buzz
list.text: Early reviews call {d}'s film the best of the season.
